cues.en: In the last lecture we added the Idempotency model and made the migrations.
cues.zh: 上一堂加入冪等鍵模型，並執行遷移。

cues.en: Now let's add other schema definitions that are going to be useful for the transfer functionality, as we're going to go back to our IDE.
cues.zh: 現在加入轉帳功能需要的其他 schema，回到 IDE。

cues.en: Then you're going to open a schema within backend app transaction.
cues.zh: 開啟 backend/app/transaction 裡的 schema。

cues.en: Then after the deposit request schema we're now going to create the transfer request schema.
cues.zh: 在 DepositRequestSchema 後面，建立 TransferRequestSchema。

cues.en: And this is the schema that is going to be used to handle transfer requests.
cues.zh: 這個 schema 用來處理轉帳請求。

cues.en: So you're going to say class that's going to be transfer request schema.
cues.zh: 定義 class TransferRequestSchema。

cues.en: That's going to subclass the SQL model.
cues.zh: 繼承 SQLModel。

cues.en: Then you're first going to add the Uuid of the sender's account.
cues.zh: 先加入匯款帳戶的 UUID。

cues.en: So you can say sender account ID that's going to be of type Uuid.
cues.zh: sender_account_id 的型別為 UUID。

cues.en: Then the receiver's account number.
cues.zh: 接著收款帳號。

cues.en: So you can say receiver underscore account number.
cues.zh: 設定 receiver_account_number。

cues.en: That's going to be of type string.
cues.zh: 型別為 str。

cues.en: Then for the field we're going to set the minimum length of 16 and maximum length of 16.
cues.zh: Field 的 min_length 與 max_length 都設為 16。

cues.en: So we're setting the minimum length and maximum length to 16.
cues.zh: 最小與最大長度都設為 16。

cues.en: Because as you can remember before our account numbers should be exactly 16 characters.
cues.zh: 因為記得帳號必須剛好是 16 個字元。

cues.en: Then the amount to transfer that's going to be of type decimal.
cues.zh: 接著是轉帳金額，型別為 Decimal。

cues.en: Then for this field we're going to set greater than or equal to zero.
cues.zh: Field 設定大於或等於 0。

cues.en: Then the maximum number of decimal places which should be two.
cues.zh: 最大小數位數為 2。

cues.en: Then the security answer for verification was going to have a security answer that's going to be of a string type.
cues.zh: 再加入驗證用的 security_answer，型別為 str。

cues.en: Then for this field we're going to set the maximum length of 30 characters.
cues.zh: Field 的 max_length 設為 30 個字元。

cues.en: Then the description of the transfer.
cues.zh: 接著轉帳描述。

cues.en: So you can say description that's going to be of type string.
cues.zh: description 的型別為 str。

cues.en: And for this field it's going to be a maximum of 250 characters.
cues.zh: 最多 250 個字元。

cues.en: Then after that we're going to create a transfer OTP verification schema, which is going to be used to handle OTP verification for the transfers.
cues.zh: 再建立 TransferOTPVerificationSchema，處理轉帳 OTP 驗證。

cues.en: As you can see, class that's going to be transfer OTP verification schema, that's going to subclass the SQL model.
cues.zh: 定義 class TransferOTPVerificationSchema，繼承 SQLModel。

cues.en: Then we're going to add the reference of the transfer.
cues.zh: 加入轉帳參考編號。

cues.en: As you can see transfer underscore reference that's going to be of type string.
cues.zh: transfer_reference 的型別為 str。

cues.en: Then the OTP to verify is OTP that's going to be of type string.
cues.zh: 要驗證的 otp，型別為 str。

cues.en: And for this OTP field it has to be a minimum of six characters and maximum of six.
cues.zh: 這個欄位最短 6 個字元、最長也是 6 個。

cues.en: Because remember our OTP must be exactly six characters.
cues.zh: 因為 OTP 必須剛好是 6 個字元。

cues.en: Then we're going to define the transfer response schema, which is going to be a schema to be used to handle the response for transfers.
cues.zh: 再定義 TransferResponseSchema，處理轉帳回應。

cues.en: As you can see, class transfer response schema that's going to subclass the SQL model.
cues.zh: 定義 class TransferResponseSchema，繼承 SQLModel。

cues.en: Then we're going to have the status of the transfer whether it's successful or failed etc..
cues.zh: 包含轉帳狀態，例如成功或失敗等。

cues.en: So status that's going to be of type string.
cues.zh: status 的型別為 str。

cues.en: Then you're going to have a message which is going to provide additional information about the transfer status.
cues.zh: message 提供轉帳狀態的額外資訊。

cues.en: So you can say message that's going to be of type string.
cues.zh: message 的型別為 str。

cues.en: Then we're going to have an optional data field for any additional response details.
cues.zh: 再加入選填的 data 欄位，放額外回應詳細資料。

cues.en: As you can see data that's going to be a dictionary or none.
cues.zh: data 的型別為 dict 或 None。

cues.en: And by default this field is going to be optional.
cues.zh: 預設為選填。

cues.en: So none.
cues.zh: 因此是 None。

cues.en: Then we're also going to create a schema of our currency conversions.
cues.zh: 也要建立貨幣換算的 schema。

cues.en: As you can see class currency conversion schema that's going to subclass the SQL model.
cues.zh: 定義 class CurrencyConversionSchema，繼承 SQLModel。

cues.en: Then it's going to have the amount to be converted and the amount is going to be over a decimal type.
cues.zh: 包含要換算的 amount，型別為 Decimal。

cues.en: Then the currency code for the original currency, as you can see from currency, that's going to be of type string.
cues.zh: 原始貨幣的代碼 from_currency，型別為 str。

cues.en: Then we're going to have the currency code of the target currency.
cues.zh: 接著是目標貨幣的代碼。

cues.en: As you can see two currency because you're converting from this currency to this currency.
cues.zh: to_currency，因為要從這種貨幣換成另一種。

cues.en: This is also going to be of type string.
cues.zh: 型別也是 str。

cues.en: Then the exchange rate for conversion.
cues.zh: 再來是換算匯率。

cues.en: As you can see exchange underscore rate that's going to be decimal.
cues.zh: exchange_rate 的型別為 Decimal。

cues.en: Then the original amount before conversion.
cues.zh: 換算前的原始金額。

cues.en: As you can see original amount that's going to be over decimal type.
cues.zh: original_amount 的型別為 Decimal。

cues.en: Then the amount after conversion.
cues.zh: 接著換算後金額。

cues.en: As you can see converted amount that's going to be of type decimal.
cues.zh: converted_amount 的型別為 Decimal。

cues.en: Then the conversion fee applied.
cues.zh: 再來是換匯費用。

cues.en: As you can see conversion underscore fee that's going to be decimal type.
cues.zh: conversion_fee 的型別為 Decimal。

cues.en: Then for this field we're going to set the default to decimal.
cues.zh: Field 的 default 使用 Decimal。

cues.en: And the default value is going to be 0.00 like that.
cues.zh: 預設值為 0.00。

cues.en: Then you can save that file.
cues.zh: 儲存檔案。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: That's it for this lecture.
cues.zh: 這堂課就到這裡。

cues.en: In the next lecture we shall create our transaction utilities.
cues.zh: 下一堂建立交易工具函式。
